name: Staff of Obstacles
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 199, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 297
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 199, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 297
Aura moderate varies CL 9th
Slot none; Price 52,850 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
Dark and solid, this worn staff appears to be carved of rough stone, yet feels and weighs like light wood. It allows use of the following spells:
Arcane lock (1 charge)
Grease (1 charge)
Wind wall (1 charge)
Wall of fire (2 charges)
Wall of ice (2 charges)
Wall of stone (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, arcane lock, grease, wall of fire, wall of ice, wall of stone, wind wall; Cost 27,050 gp
